visualCharacteristics.purpose: Teasers for tools or pages with image, heading, text and a text link
visualCharacteristics.description: 3-up teasers: tall image on top, heading, paragraph and chevron text link below

contentPattern.structure: image cell, then a text cell with heading, paragraph and link
contentPattern.rationale: Look-alike items (image, title, text, link) each pointing to a different page that wrap on smaller screens: Cards, not Columns.

reuseGuidance: Use for teasers pointing to tools or pages with a short description. Use cards-swatch for image-plus-name galleries.

blockContent.description: Three teasers: Visualize Your Design, Explore Designs, Visit a Showroom; image, H3, paragraph, link

rows: Text: optional heading, description, CTA link
structure.notes: One row per card. Section 2: image + linked design name paragraph. Section 4: image + H3 linked title. Section 6: image + H3 + paragraph + link.

usageDescription: 3-up teasers (1-up mobile, 2-up tablet): tall image, heading, paragraph and a chevron text link. One row per card: image cell, text cell.
